I'm a lady and have been getting more and more into strengthening/weight training, to the point where I'm taking a class so I've got other folks to train with/share experiences & exercises with/check form. The form check is one of the biggest benefits, along with having more equipment available than at home, and knowing the group setting holds me more accountable than doing it solo.

Our instructor is teaching us multiple moves for different muscle groups, with the idea of us doing full-body workouts each class. We're also looking up exercises we'd like to try and bringing those in to work on.

Personally, when looking online for exercises to bring to class, I wound up pulling all of them from this site. You select a muscle group to start and it brings you to exercise guides for that group - from there, you can filter by muscles targeted, exercise type, equipment, etc. Click on an exercise and it provides a plethora of info. It even allows you to select male or female so you can see images/videos of either sex performing the exercise!

Generally speaking, I found more helpful info on "men's" workout sites vs "women's" workout sites. Why?? Because I want to get toned and strengthened all over for my health, not because I wanted to "firm my bust" (I can't tell you how many times I found that phrase when searching online). For an example, here's the Men's Health fitness section, and here's the Women's Health fitness section. Scrolling through the two shows MH focused much more on actual workouts, while WH was inundated with articles about real women, workout gear, post-workout snacks... everything but the actual workouts!
